# Vendored map assets

These files are pinned to keep map rendering available without runtime CDN dependencies.

- Leaflet 1.9.4: `leaflet/leaflet.js`, `leaflet/leaflet.css`, `leaflet/images/`, and `leaflet/LICENSE`
- Leaflet.heat 0.2.0: `leaflet-heat/leaflet-heat.js` and `leaflet-heat/LICENSE`

Source packages were retrieved from the official npm packages through unpkg. Vendor licenses remain beside each implementation.
